name: Mjolnir_ReturningThunderHammer
description: Reworks the vanilla Frostner (MaceSilver) into Mjolnir, the returning thunder hammer. Throw it (secondary attack), then aim at it and press secondary attack again - thunder, one flip, a smooth flight, and it lands handle-first in your hand with auto-equip. No new items. Commands: mjolnir give / restyle.
